**Interpretation**
The forecast implies no expected drift from the last close over the horizon. It does not imply that the price will stay unchanged, and it offers no directional signal or information on volatility. Because the model did not outperform a simple carry-forward of the last price, it adds little predictive value here. Treat it as a neutral reference point rather than a basis for decisions.
